text: A03 order test, rules written before it runs (G35): the census of my D3a-30 rulings by room, out/_analysis/d3_a03_census.py. Each line takes the class it was ruled under: instantiate O, BOUND, J, ONE, OTHER, P-G6 (A03-inst-spec.txt); restrict S-O, S-BOUND, S-HELD, EL (A03-restrict-spec.txt); add lines the order where the reason names A03's own order, else held by a statement; absent rejects the order, particulars other, accepts evidence limits. Every class is checked against the decision and kind in the written files. A room counts in each class its lines show, and once by priority (order, bound, J, held, one end, EL, other, limit). An episode is the order or the bound; J rooms are counted apart, as G35 says; rooms with both the order and the bound are counted. The count is reported beside C2's (148 of 190, 0.779). Reading rule: the counts inform the status ruling and its bound; no line ruling changes because of a count

Beside C2's first-concept count (148 of 190, 0.779), the read lines show the order in more rooms and the bound in fewer. Most of the 95 one-end lines are a bare cheer followed by upkeep ('We did it! Now we must defend it'): G15 does not count a bare cheer as a report of the work, so these show P11's marking and P05's upkeep, not P03 before P05. Reading: no correction, so section 2 is not triggered; A03 stands as served. Carried to D4 and D3c's re-read: the turn from a cheer to upkeep is the commonest form of the spine's last link in the members' own words

G36 readings stated while ruling the first instantiate packet, before any A04 line is written; they read G36 and change no ruling rule: (1) proposals to ask: G36 reads P08 by G18 and its readings, so a member's proposal inside the room to ask another room, with no request shown made ('We need to talk to them', 'Diplomacy is our only option now'), is not P08's terms; such a line is rejected and the census counts it apart (class ASK). G36's own example pair (unturned c0059 then c0060, 'Maybe we can arrange something') shows the order of words; its second post is such a proposal, as is adventuretime c0065, so both of A04's support transitions show upkeep then a proposal to talk, not terms; carried to D3c's re-read. A request reported made or under way by the speaker counts ('I have tried to contact them', 'I'm going into their discord'). (2) damage inside the talk (class J, as G35 counted it): where the talk names the damage only as its reason or condition ('as long as you tell your brethren to stop invading'), or the talk is itself the means of defence ('negotiations to defend 50 pixels'), and no act of upkeep or defence comes before it, the order cannot be read; rejected and counted apart from the bound. (3) a loss or a move in place of upkeep (class MOVE): the room moves away instead of talking terms, or seeks a new place by talk after its spot is lost (P10, A10; K02 where it says it lacks hands); rejected and counted apart. (4) a call to defend or protect counts as P05 before any damage (G11, P01's hold form); a warning that a neighbour approaches is not upkeep, since G11's watching warns that the work is changed. (5) a neighbour's terms after the room's upkeep show the order (G18 reads P08 from either room's record), and a visitor's post that names both sides' fighting and then offers terms counts (TheHulk-035, livecounting-022). (6) the bound (class BOUND): the line shows the room's talk before any upkeep or damage (space asked while building, terms before damage, a treaty before any attack)
